narrative.overview: Nunito Sans typography and the Endesga 32 mascot palette over Doxygen Awesome.
keyCharacteristics: Nunito Sans Regular and Bold for reading and headings.
JetBrains Mono reserved for code and signatures.
Brand blue light theme; neutral graphite dark theme with soft blue links.
Right page outline, Mermaid SVG diagrams, Nord code blocks and bottom-right GitHub corner.
Independent rail controls, inline native graphs, keyboard access and read-only WebMCP tools.
dos: Preserve original mascot artwork and authored content.
Keep the 1200px content cap and accessible reading controls.
donts: Do not apply code theme colors to the page backgrounds.
Do not convert Mermaid into ASCII.
